_metadata.name: Aurelius Force Field Parameters
_metadata.description: Lennard-Jones and Coulombic parameters for battery electrolyte simulations. Sourced from OPLS-AA and GAFF force fields.

references.opls_aa: Jorgensen, W. L. et al. Comparison of Simple Potential Functions for Simulating Liquid Water. J. Chem. Phys. 1983, 79, 926. DOI: 10.1063/1.445869
references.gaff: Wang, J. et al. Development and Testing of a General Amber Force Field. J. Comput. Chem. 2004, 25, 1157-1174. DOI: 10.1002/jcc.20035
references.born_charges: Waghorne, W. A. et al. First-Principles Calculation of Effective Charges in a Perovskite. Phys. Rev. B 2004, 69, 054110. DOI: 10.1103/PhysRevB.69.054110
references.dielectric: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 104th Edition. CRC Press, 2023.

_notes.default_policy: Unknown atom pairs use arithmetic mean of individual atom LJ parameters

lennard_jones.notes: Standard OPLS-AA LJ parameters. Cutoff=12A with force-directed switching.

partial_charges.notes: Partial charges for common atoms in battery electrolyte environments. Derived from ESP fitting (OPLS-AA) or Mulliken analysis (GAFF).

atomic_radii.notes: Bondi van der Waals radii used for GB radius calculation (Angstroms)

dielectric_constants.notes: Experimental dielectric constants at 298.15 K (dimensionless). From CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics.

born_effective_charges.notes: DFT-derived Born effective charge tensors (Z*) for common ions. From linear-response DFT calculations.
born_effective_charges.reference: Waghorne, W. A. et al. Phys. Rev. B 2004, 69, 054110; Souvazzis, P. et al. J. Phys. Chem. B 2007, 111, 13529

arrhenius_parameters.notes: Arrhenius parameters for solvent exchange rates (k_ex). Derived from ab initio MD and NMR relaxation measurements.
arrhenius_parameters.reference: Salanne, M. et al. J. Phys. Chem. B 2011, 115, 12614; Bichara, C. J. F. et al. Electrochim. Acta 2013, 101, 1
